source_selection: First eight lexically ordered JPEG sequence directories with at least36 frames, retaining only first sequence per name-before-hyphen family. All are excluded from earlier OpenCV/imageio development and test sources.
frame_isolation: Evenly spaced eligible target positions i%4 in{2,3}; endpoints i-2,i+2 in{0,1}; global target/endpoint intersection empty within every source.
canonical_resize: RGB, width256, proportional height, Pillow BOX; source preparation is timed separately and shared by arms
development: Only old David/Dudek/Faceocc2 train/validation frames; no historical test frame used for new model selection
model: DIS optical flow selected on old validation; one convex RGB interpolation coefficient learned by exact least-squares on old train targets
acceptance: efficient_learned versus old_learned_mixer: paired source-bootstrap95percentCI lowerPSNRdifference>=-0.25, upperCPUdifference<0, upperwalldifference<0. Training attribution requires learned minus same-solver alpha0.5 PSNR lowerCI>0. Report pixelMSE separately.
uncertainty: 5000 paired family/sequence cluster resamples, seed2811; allframes/repetitions stay within source; source-generalization bounded to eight selected scenes
cost: Charge endpoint file decode, both flow calls, inverse mapping, pixel mixing, PNG write/readback, hash, metadata. Model selection/development and source preparation separately reported. No per-frame learned gate if validation selects a fixed solver.
scope: Natural missing-frame generation and actual compute reduction; no claim of semantic video synthesis, adaptive allocation superiority, Hepta integration, or general multimodal LLM training.
stopping: Freeze model, protocol, dependencies, source identities and exact code before any heldout generation. No retuning after test. Retain failures.
